guide.title: App registration in Entra ID
guide.description: Steps for IT and for whoever runs the platform. Done once per environment (QA and PRD).

register.title: Create the registration
register.intro: In the Microsoft Entra portal, App registrations, New registration.
steps: Name: SAPExtract QA or SAPExtract PRD, depending on the environment.
Supported account types: accounts in this organizational directory only.
Redirect URI: Web platform, with the URI shown on the configuration screen.
Under Authentication, leave the implicit flow tokens and «Allow public client flows» unchecked.
Copy the directory (tenant) ID and the application (client) ID from the overview page.

credential.title: Create the credential
credential.intro: Under Certificates & secrets. A certificate is the recommended option.
steps: Certificate: generate it on a trusted machine with the command below and upload only the .crt file to the registration.
Paste the .crt and the .key into the platform, save, and delete the key from the machine.
Client secret, if there is no certificate: New client secret expiring in 12 months. Copy the value right away and note the expiry date.
Never send the key or the secret by email or chat: load them here directly.
credential.commandIntro: 3072-bit RSA certificate valid for one year:
credential.command: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 365 -nodes -keyout sapextract.key -out sapextract.crt -subj "/CN=SAPExtract PRD"

groups.title: Send groups in the token
groups.intro: Under Token configuration, Add groups claim.
steps: In the ID token, as group ID.
Copy each group's object ID (Groups, the group, Overview) into the groups and roles table.
If someone belongs to more than 200 groups, the token does not include them all: the GroupMember.Read.All permission will be needed.

permissions.title: API permissions
permissions.intro: Under API permissions, Microsoft Graph, delegated permissions.
steps: Only if users have more than 200 groups: GroupMember.Read.All, with admin consent.

activate.title: Test and enable
activate.intro: Back in the platform, on the configuration screen.
steps: Save the IDs and the credential.
Select Test configuration: it checks the tenant, the signing keys and that Entra accepts the client ID and the credential.
The redirect URI and the groups are only checked on the first real sign-in.
Map groups to roles and enable Entra ID.

modeHint.ODQ: The source has ODQ delta: the first run initializes the subscription.

modeHint.NONE: The source has no delta: full load only.

detail.closePending: The previous subscription may still be open in ODQMON. Close it there and confirm, or declare that you leave it open, before initializing again.

detail.scheduleNotSaved: The pipeline was saved, but the schedule was not

reset.title: Reset the delta of {{code}}
reset.message: The next run performs a full initialization. The current subscription stays pending closure in ODQMON.

closed.title: Confirm closure in SAP
closed.message: Confirm that you deleted the previous subscription in ODQMON. Then the delta can be initialized again.

left_open.title: Leave the previous subscription open
left_open.message: The previous subscription queue keeps growing in SAP. Say why you leave it open.

delete.title: Delete {{code}}?
delete.message: The pipeline and its schedule are removed. Data already loaded and the run history are kept. If it had a delta, its subscription stays pending closure in SAP.

pause.title: Pause {{code}}?
pause.message: No more runs will be launched until you resume it. The one in progress finishes.
pause.delta: While paused, the delta queue keeps growing in SAP. A long pause may force a delta reinitialization.

pipelines.onlyDestination: Only the pipelines that load into the chosen destination.
pipelines.onlySource: Only the pipelines that read from the chosen source.

extractionHints.FULL: Reads every row of the source on each run.
extractionHints.DELTA: Reads only the changes SAP keeps in the delta queue since the last run.
extractionHints.WATERMARK: Reads the rows whose watermark field is later than the last run.

loadHints.append: Inserts the rows read without touching the existing ones.
loadHints.upsert: Updates the rows that already exist by key and inserts the new ones.
loadHints.replace: Empties the destination and loads it again in full.

runs.onlyOnePipeline: Only the runs of one pipeline.
runs.emptyFirst: Runs appear here when an active pipeline is launched, by hand or by its schedule.

workers.noneOnline: No workers are online, so the queue does not move. Start the worker process.
workers.noExecutor: The online workers do not have the extraction engine installed, so runs stay queued. Tell whoever administers the platform.

message.running: The worker stops when it finishes the page it is reading. What is already committed to the destination is not undone.
message.queued: The run leaves the queue without starting.

errorNext.transient: It is a transient error: check that the SAP system and the destination respond and press “Retry”.
errorNext.configuration: It is a configuration error: fix the pipeline, the source or the destination before retrying.
errorNext.data: It is a data error: review the rows the destination rejects before retrying.
